name: Inferelator 3.0
method_summary: Inferelator 3.0 infers directed gene regulatory networks by estimating transcription factor activity from expression data constrained by a prior knowledge network, then regressing gene expression against that activity estimate with regularized model-selection methods. The Python package supports bulk and single-cell transcriptome data and includes BBSR, StARS-LASSO and multi-task regression strategies.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_native so Inferelator can create native multitask group tasks from metadata.

progress.note: Progress can be estimated from the per-response-gene BBSR regression loop; the total is the number of target genes after Inferelator filtering and prior/expression alignment.

regression.description: Inferelator regression engine. auto maps to bbsr for global/group_emulated execution and amusr for group_native execution; group_native also accepts bbsr-by-task and elasticnet-by-task.

num_bootstraps.description: Number of bootstrap inference runs before fitting the final full model.

random_seed.description: Random seed used for bootstrap sampling and BBSR reproducibility.

bsr_feature_num.description: Number of candidate predictors retained for Bayesian best subset regression after prior/CLR feature selection.

prior_weight.description: Weight assigned to predictors present in the prior network during BBSR.

no_prior_weight.description: Weight assigned to predictors absent from the prior network during BBSR.

clr_only.description: If true, use Context Likelihood of Relatedness exclusively for BBSR predictor selection instead of retaining prior edges.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined stdout/stderr log from the Inferelator run.
